key.name: palette
key.description: Which canon circuitry color the bar wears. The background is the same blueish deep black for every choice — only the circuit color changes. Values follow the Program lore: tron (blue), iso (white), clu (gold), rinzler (orange), sark (red), military (teal green), utility (violet). Scriptable via `gsettings set org.gnome.shell.extensions.modernbar palette clu`.

key.name: night-mode
key.description: Kept so existing scripts keep working: when this key CHANGES, the extension maps true → palette 'clu' and false → palette 'tron'. Not shown in prefs; new scripts should set `palette` directly.

key.name: theme-popups
key.description: Extend the palette to the Quick Settings and clock/calendar dropdowns. Off leaves both stock Adwaita (the panel itself is still themed). Kept as its own switch because these popups live outside #panel and lean on stock GNOME selectors — if a shell upgrade ever breaks them, this is the one-flip escape hatch that does not require disabling the extension.

key.name: dismiss-on-leave
key.summary: Close dropdowns when the pointer leaves
key.description: Close the Quick Settings and clock/calendar dropdowns when the pointer moves away from them, matching how the metric dropdowns behave. Click-outside, Escape and keyboard navigation are unchanged — this only adds a reason to close. Dismissal is suppressed while a mouse button is held, so dragging a slider past the pane edge is safe, and it only takes effect once the pointer has entered the dropdown, so menus opened from the keyboard are left alone.

key.name: work-start
key.description: Start of the work day, "HH:MM" 24-hour. Workday % counts from here.

key.name: work-end
key.description: End of the work day, "HH:MM" 24-hour. The metric hides outside these hours.

key.name: show-workday
key.description: Master toggle for the Workday percentage indicator.

key.name: location-label
key.description: City name shown/searched. Geocoded to coordinates when changed in prefs.

key.name: latitude
key.description: Latitude used for the Open-Meteo weather query. Usually set by geocoding the location name in prefs; directly editable there too (offline / privacy / geocoder-down fallback).

key.name: longitude
key.description: Longitude used for the Open-Meteo weather query. See latitude.

key.name: temperature-unit
key.description: Unit for the weather readout: fahrenheit or celsius.

key.name: weather-refresh-minutes
key.description: How often to re-fetch weather from Open-Meteo.

key.name: show-weather
key.description: Master toggle for the weather indicator.

key.name: show-cpu
key.description: Master toggle for the CPU percentage indicator.

key.name: cpu-refresh-seconds
key.description: How often to sample /proc/stat for the CPU percentage.

key.name: cpu-warn-percent
key.description: At or above this CPU %, the value flares Clu-orange as an alert.

key.name: show-claude
key.description: Master toggle for the Claude 5-hour usage indicator.

key.name: claude-refresh-seconds
key.description: How often to query the account usage endpoint. 30s is the shipped default because 15s was measured returning 429 rate_limit_error repeatedly (worse with more than one shell session polling at once). The floor is 10s for experimentation; failures keep the last value, cache it across restarts and retry, so too-fast degrades to "stale" rather than "gone".

key.name: claude-cache-percent
key.description: -1 = no cached value. Internal; not shown in prefs.

key.name: claude-cache-time
key.summary: Unix time of the cached utilization
key.description: Epoch seconds. The cache is ignored once older than an hour, since the 5-hour window will have moved on. Internal; not in prefs.

key.name: claude-warn-percent
key.description: At or above this 5-hour utilization %, the value flares Clu-orange.
